summary: The change only makes a gate stricter. .github/workflows/ci.yml line 102 goes from `npm audit --audit-level=critical` to `--audit-level=high`; the shipped-deps audit (`--omit=dev --audit-level=high`) is unchanged. Nothing hides an advisory: no .npmrc, no audit-level/ignore config, no continue-on-error, and both audit steps still run straight after `npm ci`. CI permissions did not change: the workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` is unchanged, every action is still pinned to a full commit SHA, and no triggers, secrets or new steps were added. package.json and package-lock.json are unchanged, so there are no new dependencies. Both `npm audit --audit-level=high` and `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` report 0 vulnerabilities locally, so the stricter gate passes. Test and README edits only change the expected string. The other files in the diff are doit/backlog bookkeeping with no security impact. No findings.
